verdict.rationale: The evidence shows each app has a dedicated MCP server selectable via the x-pd-app-slug header, and that the client loads all available tools. Neither is a documented allowlist or per-tool access control a platform engineer could enforce. The mention of Conduit adding 'security and observability' is too vague to show server or tool restriction policies.

support.subject: As a platform-engineer, I can restrict which servers and individual tools an agent may call through allowlists or per-tool access control
